def SigmaNonprimarity.Theorem_1_1.{u} : Prop :=
∃ L X Xtilde,
  And
    (Nonempty.{u + 1}
      (ContinuousLinearEquiv.{0, 0, u, u} (RingHom.id.{0} Real)
        (ContinuousMap.{u, 0} (ThesisCommon.Compactum.Carrier.{u} L) Real)
        (Prod.{u, u} (ThesisCommon.RealBanachSpace.Carrier.{u} X) (ThesisCommon.RealBanachSpace.Carrier.{u} Xtilde))))
    (And (Not (ThesisCommon.IsomorphicToBanachLattice.{u} (ThesisCommon.RealBanachSpace.Carrier.{u} X)))
      (Not (ThesisCommon.IsomorphicToBanachLattice.{u} (ThesisCommon.RealBanachSpace.Carrier.{u} Xtilde))))
def SigmaNonprimarity.CKCounterexample.{u} : Prop :=
∃ L X Xtilde,
  Nonempty (C(L.Carrier, ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] X.Carrier × Xtilde.Carrier) ∧
    ¬ThesisCommon.IsomorphicToCK X.Carrier ∧ ¬ThesisCommon.IsomorphicToCK Xtilde.Carrier

def ThesisCommon.IsomorphicToBanachLattice.{u} : (E : Type u) →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [NormedSpace ℝ E] → Prop :=
fun E [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] => ∃ F, Nonempty (E ≃L[ℝ] F.Carrier)
def ThesisCommon.IsCNorming.{u_1} : {E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] → (ℕ → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) → ℝ → Prop :=
fun {E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] e c =>
  0 < c ∧ c ≤ 1 ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ), ‖e n‖ ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ (x : E), c * ‖x‖ ≤ ⨆ n, |(e n) x|
def ThesisCommon.DesiredProperty.{u_2} : (E : Type u_2) → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [NormedSpace ℝ E] → Prop :=
fun E [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] =>
  ∀ (e : ℕ → E →L[ℝ] ℝ), ThesisCommon.IsNorming e → ∃ f, ¬∃ g, ∀ (n : ℕ), (e n) g = |(e n) f|
def SigmaNonprimarity.Proposition_3_4.{u} : (E : Type u) →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [NormedSpace ℝ E] → [CompleteSpace E] → Prop :=
fun E [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] =>
  (∃ e, ThesisCommon.IsNorming e) →
    (∃ Γ, Nonempty ((E →L[ℝ] ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] ↥(lp (fun x => ℝ) 1))) →
      (ThesisCommon.IsomorphicToBanachLattice E ↔ SigmaNonprimarity.IsomorphicToSublatticeEllInfinity E) ∧
        (SigmaNonprimarity.IsomorphicToSublatticeEllInfinity E ↔ ¬ThesisCommon.DesiredProperty E)
def SigmaNonprimarity.Lemma_4_7 : Prop :=
∀ (C : Set ℕ) (μ : ℕ → ↥(lp (fun x => ℝ) 1)),
  C.Infinite →
    SigmaNonprimarity.Admissible μ →
      ∃ J₀ J₁ J₂ Z a δ,
        J₂ ⊆ J₁ ∧
          J₁ ⊆ J₀ ∧
            J₀ ⊆ C ∧
              J₂.Infinite ∧
                (J₁ \ J₂).Infinite ∧
                  (J₀ \ J₁).Infinite ∧
                    SigmaNonprimarity.Splits J₁ Z ∧
                      a ≥ ⨅ n, |↑(μ n) (n, false)| ∧
                        0 < δ ∧
                          δ < (⨅ n, |↑(μ n) (n, false)|) / 11 ∧
                            (∀ n ∈ J₂,
                                |SigmaNonprimarity.mass (μ n) Z -
                                        SigmaNonprimarity.mass (μ n) (SigmaNonprimarity.cylinder J₁ \ Z) -
                                      2 * a| <
                                  3 * δ) ∧
                              (∀ n ∈ J₁ \ J₂,
                                  |SigmaNonprimarity.mass (μ n) Z -
                                          SigmaNonprimarity.mass (μ n) (SigmaNonprimarity.cylinder J₁ \ Z) +
                                        2 * a| <
                                    3 * δ) ∧
                                ∀ n ∈ J₀ \ J₁,
                                  |SigmaNonprimarity.mass (μ n) Z -
                                        SigmaNonprimarity.mass (μ n) (SigmaNonprimarity.cylinder J₁ \ Z)| <
                                    3 * δ
SigmaNonprimarity.theorem_1_1_of_crossed_decompositions.{u} (K L : ThesisCommon.Compactum)
  (A B C D : ThesisCommon.RealBanachSpace) (e : C(K.Carrier, ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] A.Carrier × B.Carrier)
  (f : C(L.Carrier, ℝ) ≃L[ℝ] C.Carrier × D.Carrier)
  (hCB : ¬ThesisCommon.IsomorphicToBanachLattice (C.Carrier × B.Carrier))
  (hAD : ¬ThesisCommon.IsomorphicToBanachLattice (A.Carrier × D.Carrier)) : SigmaNonprimarity.Theorem_1_1
SigmaNonprimarity.no_modulus_of_three_levels.{u_1} {E : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  (e : ℕ → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (he : ∀ (n : ℕ), ‖e n‖ ≤ 1) (f : E) (H : Submodule ℝ E) (J₀ J₁ J₂ : Set ℕ) (a δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
  (ha : 11 * δ < a) (hp : ∀ n ∈ J₂, |(e n) f - 2 * a| < 3 * δ) (hm : ∀ n ∈ J₁ \ J₂, |(e n) f - -(2 * a)| < 3 * δ)
  (hz : ∀ n ∈ J₀ \ J₁, |(e n) f| < 3 * δ) (hdense : ∀ (g : E), ∃ r, ∃ s ∈ H, ‖g - (r • f + s)‖ < δ)
  (hsep₁ : ∀ s ∈ H, ¬SigmaNonprimarity.UniformGap (fun n => (e n) s) J₁ (J₀ \ J₁))
  (hsep₂ : ∀ s ∈ H, ¬SigmaNonprimarity.UniformGap (fun n => (e n) s) J₂ (J₁ \ J₂)) :
  ¬∃ g, ∀ (n : ℕ), (e n) g = |(e n) f|
